title: A Frog the Size of a Paperclip Carries Enough Poison to Kill 10 People

scenes.text: A frog the size of a paperclip carries enough poison to kill ten people.
The golden poison frog. Bright yellow, two inches long, from one corner of Colombia.
Its skin is coated in batrachotoxin. A few grains of salt's worth could stop a human heart.
For centuries, local hunters have tipped their blowgun darts with its skin.
The weird part: raised in captivity, it's harmless. The poison comes from the insects it eats in the wild.
The most poisonous animal on Earth would fit in a matchbox.

description:
The golden poison frog of Colombia's Pacific rainforest is only 1.6 to 2.4 inches long but carries enough batrachotoxin to kill around ten adult humans, the most poisonous frog on Earth.
The Embera people have tipped blowgun darts with its skin toxin for centuries. Frogs raised in captivity away from their wild insect diet never become poisonous.
Would you dare to hold one in captivity, knowing it is harmless?
first_comment: The bright yellow is a warning sign: almost nothing in the forest will try to eat it. Which is more dangerous in your opinion, venom or poison?
